name.zh: 扶椅站姿弓步屈髋拉伸

purpose.zh: 拉伸髋前侧，缓解久坐紧张
purpose.en: Stretch the front of your hip to ease tightness from sitting.

text.zh: 骨盆后卷，向前推，拉伸后腿髋前侧
text.en: Tuck your pelvis and glide forward to stretch the front of the back hip

text.zh: 前后分腿站，后脚前掌着地，手扶椅背
text.en: Stand in a split stance, back heel up, hand on the chair.

text.zh: 双膝微屈，上身保持直立
text.en: Bend both knees a little and keep your trunk upright.

cautions.zh: 腰部疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
